components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid var(--border, #222a38); border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); background: var(--surface, #10141c); overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #181f2b); background: var(--surface-elevated, #151b26); } .ds-card-id { font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-weight: 700; color: var(--text, #f3f6fb); } .ds-card-link { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--accent-text, #7dd3fc); } .ds-card-body { padding: 12px; } .ds-card-val { font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 1.375rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text, #f3f6fb); margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-card-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; border-top: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #181f2b); padding-top: 8px; } .ds-card-grid > div + div { border-left: 1px solid var(--border-subtle, #181f2b); padding-left: 10px; } .ds-card-grid span { display: block; font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--muted, #8b99ad); } .ds-card-grid strong { font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--text, #f3f6fb); } .ds-card-grid strong.is-bad { color: var(--bad-text, #fb7185); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; background: var(--surface, #10141c); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #222a38); } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 36px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius, 6px); color: var(--text-secondary, #c2ccd9); font-size: 0.8125rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: color 120ms ease, background-color 120ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--text, #f3f6fb); background: var(--surface-hover, #1a2230); } .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--text, #f3f6fb); background: var(--accent-bg, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.12)); border-color: var(--accent-border, rgba(56, 189, 248, 0.38)); } .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"]::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 8px; right: 8px; bottom: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--accent, #38bdf8); } .ds-nav-link.is-ro { color: var(--readonly-text, #c4b5fd); font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 0.75rem; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #38bdf8); outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
Bubble Buster is designed as a calm, precision-instrument monitoring desk for live cryptocurrency futures operations. Surfaces stay dark, flat, and disciplined so real risk signals — portfolio stop proximity, execution failures, and equity drawdowns — cut through immediately without decorative noise.

Hierarchy relies on tonal graphite stepping, crisp 1px hairlines, and tabular monospace figures rather than drop shadows or marketing flourishes. Every pixel on screen earns its place by answering an operational question: is the fleet healthy, how fresh is the snapshot, how close is each account to its stop threshold, and what failed?
keyCharacteristics: Deep obsidian-slate surfaces stepped in tight neutral intervals with 1px hairline borders.

Strictly decoupled semantic hues: cyan for navigation/telemetry focus, emerald for healthy/positive PnL, amber for caution/waiting, crimson for losses/stop/failure, and violet reserved exclusively for read-only accounts.
Tabular monospace numerals (tabular-nums) for all prices, equity figures, percentages, timestamps, and counts.
Flat-by-default containers with hairline internal dividers instead of nested cards.

rules.name: The Readonly Violet Quarantine Rule
rules.body: Violet is never used for strategy phases, alerts, or decorative highlights; seeing violet anywhere instantly signals a read-only non-trading account.

rules.name: The Calm-Until-Broken Rule
rules.body: Neutral counts (0 anomalies, 0 pending signals) remain neutral ink on neutral surfaces. Amber and crimson borders or backgrounds appear only when an actual threshold, warning, or failure is active.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: No legible UI text, badge, or chart axis label drops below 0.75rem (12px).

rules.name: The Tabular Lock Rule
rules.body: Every numeric column, KPI figure, countdown, and timestamp uses monospace font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and right-aligns inside tables.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Cards, strips, and tables never carry drop shadows at rest. Depth is expressed through tonal stepping and 1px borders; shadows appear only on floating overlays.

dos: Do keep [hidden] { display: none !important; } global in ops.css so author display rules never expose hidden controls.
Do use hairline 1px dividers and tonal stepping inside panels instead of nesting bordered cards inside cards.
Do encode status with text + shape/line-pattern in addition to color (e.g., distinct legend markers, explicit status labels, multi-pattern chart lines).
Do use native semantic primitives (<progress>, <details>, <search>, role="tablist", aria-sort) before reaching for generic <div> widgets.
Do keep all static asset references routed through web/template_loader.py for automatic content-hash ?v= versioning.
donts: Don't put one-sided colored accent bars down the side of rounded cards; highlight specific failing rows or use full subtle borders/badges instead.
Don't render CSS ::after pseudo-element tooltips inside bordered/grid containers (they inflate scrollWidth, clip under overflow: hidden, and fail screen readers).
Don't apply warning/danger colors to healthy zero states (待触发 0, 异常 0) or label stale historical snapshots as "在线快照".
Don't reuse readonly violet (#a78bfa) on managed accounts or strategy entry phases.
Don't add inline executable <script> blocks or inline <style> tags in templates (violates strict CSP script-src 'self').
